consumes : ∀ p, ¬ Disjoint (A.dome (5*radiusB x)) (startPos S p) →
      ((p ∈ A.costs → fiery G x S.patch.L/4 ≤ toll U p) ∧ (p∉A.costs → toll U p ≤ fiery G x S.patch.L/2))
  drive b : ¬ Disjoint (A.dome (5*radiusB x)) (pinPos b) →
      ((b ∈ A.aisles → w*fiery G x S.patch.L ≤ wire (S.prediction U k) V b) ∧
      (b∉A.aisles → wire (S.prediction U k) V b ≤ 2*w*fiery G x S.patch.L))

proof_context.conclusion: `Plot.consumes` and `Plot.drive` state that every fine plaquette test meeting the radius-`5*radiusB x` dome of the selection is at least `fiery/4` inside `A.costs` and at most `fiery/2` outside, and every mismatch test is at least `w*fiery` inside `A.aisles` and at most `2*w*fiery` outside.
